data.name: PortoBay Flores
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodation
PortoBay Flores offers air-conditioned rooms with modern amenities including flat-screen TVs, safety deposit boxes, and private bathrooms. Guests can unwind in the indoor pool and sauna or enjoy room service for a truly relaxing stay.

Convenient Location
Situated in the vibrant União de Freguesias do Centro district, this hotel is near popular attractions like Clerigos Tower and Palacio da Bolsa. With the airport just 17 km away, exploring Porto is a breeze from PortoBay Flores.

Exceptional Services
From the 24-hour multilingual front desk to the delicious buffet breakfast, guests are well taken care of at PortoBay Flores. Whether you need assistance or recommendations, the dedicated staff is always ready to assist you.

Book your stay at PortoBay Flores now for a memorable Porto experience!
data.hotelImportantInformation:
When booking half board, please note that drinks are not included.

The hotel is located on a pedestrian street.

Please note that the credit card used to make the payment of the reservation must be from one of the guests staying in the room. If this is not the case, please contact the hotel prior to the check-in date.

Guests are required to show a photo ID and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply.
A deposit may be required at the property.

poi.name: Port wine cellars, Vila Nova de Gaia

cons: Perceived high price / poor value for money for some guests
Minor room issues (some beds firm, dark corridor, occasional room size mix-up)
Limited car drop-off/access for guests with luggage
pros: Large, comfortable rooms with good views/balconies
Outstanding breakfast and strong F&B offerings
Nice spa/pool and attractive public areas

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Some guests noted housekeeping could be better (no evening return/turn-down, light bathroom cleaning); rooms generally clean but this was a recurrent minor complaint.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Staff repeatedly described as excellent, courteous and helpful; multiple mentions of attentive service and upgrades.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: Consistently praised as superb/central with easy walking access to shops and restaurants — a major highlight for many guests.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Rooms described as large, quiet, modern and comfortable with lovely balconies; minor issues reported (some beds a little firm, a dark corridor, one guest's second bedroom smaller than expected).

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Good spa/pool area and attractive public spaces; excellent breakfast facilities, though some guests noted limited bar/lounge activation and underused patio/library areas.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Several guests felt the hotel was expensive for the level of service received and compared unfavourably on value to other 4–5 star properties.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast repeatedly praised as sensational; food and drink described as fabulous by multiple reviewers, with only isolated criticism (e.g., coffee quality).

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Overall highly positive stays with many guests saying the hotel made them feel special; frequent comments of 'wonderful', 'fabulous' and 'everything was great'.
